_comment: Model-aware validation (BL-89 follow-up). The active model_name is read at validation time from the Jetson's app/model/classes.yaml (the model the validate Job actually runs with — the code rsync excludes model/). The reference video + expected count MUST match the active model: a pig reference video is meaningless for a sheep model (false mismatch). Lookup: (1) models[<active>].reference_video (standard) / .manifest (full); (2) if the active model has NO entry (or the file is missing) → validation_skipped (NA — not a mismatch, not an error): provide a reference video for that model + drop it in validation/videos/. Legacy: when 'models' is absent, the top-level reference_video is used (pre-BL-89 behavior). The pig model is 'my_model' (legacy fallback when classes.yaml has no model_name). expected_count is resolved per-video from the manifest, the #<N> filename, or the legacy template-validation-<N>.mp4 convention.
